<reasoning>
The PTX JIT assembler rejects non-ASCII characters. Your PTX comment on line 57 contains the Unicode “≈” character, which causes ptxas to fail with “Unexpected non-ASCII character”. Replacing that character with an ASCII-only equivalent (e.g., “~”) fixes the compile error without changing the kernel’s behavior or the Python launch code.
</reasoning>
